case.title: The Masked Heir
case.introduction: A rare painting is missing. Guests are in the mansion. All are nervous.
case.crime: The painting was stolen from the gallery.
case.escape_plan: A hidden tunnel under the garden leads to a boat.

rooms.name: Library
rooms.description: Rows of books and a desk.

rooms.name: Gallery
rooms.description: Walls with art and the stolen painting.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: Busy kitchen with ovens and a pantry.

characters.name: Lord Victor Blackwood
characters.background: Claims to be heir of a noble house.
characters.secret: He is not the real heir. He stole the name.
characters.alibi: He was in the library reading.

characters.name: Maya Chen
characters.background: Works at the museum and helped set the exhibit.
characters.secret: She once stole a sketch for a friend.
characters.alibi: She was in the gallery arranging frames.

characters.name: Thomas Reed
characters.background: Ex‑military, hired for the night shift.
characters.secret: He owes money to a loan shark.

characters.name: Lena Ortiz
characters.background: Runs the kitchen for the estate.
characters.secret: Allergic to nuts but hides it.

timeline.description: Guests arrive in the Grand Hall.
Maya checks the painting in the Gallery.
Victor says he will see the painting later.
Lena hears a noise in the Kitchen door.

evidence.name: Pocket Watch with Key
evidence.description: A gold watch with a small hidden key inside.

evidence.name: Mud Stains on Kitchen Floor
evidence.description: Fresh mud footprints leading to the pantry door.

evidence.name: Broken Glass in Gallery
evidence.description: A small shard from a window near the painting.

evidence.name: Hidden Tunnel Entrance
evidence.description: A loose stone that opens to a tunnel under the garden.

hidden_clues: Victor's watch has a key that fits the tunnel lock.
Victor said he was reading, but the book was missing.
red_herrings: Mud from the kitchen suggests Lena left the scene.
The broken glass matches Maya's glove.

solution.target_true_identity: Marco Silva, a known art thief
solution.reasoning: The pocket watch key opens the tunnel. Victor's story about the book is false. The tunnel leads out. The mud and glass are planted to blame others.

state.current_objective: Find out which guest is not who they say they are.

transcript.speaker: Verdict
transcript.text:
Your guess was wrong.  
The secret figure is Lord Victor Blackwood.  
He is really Marco Silva, the art thief.  
He used the watch key to open the tunnel and set the mud and glass to blame others.
